ActivationCode.title: ActivationCode
ActivationCode.description: One-time single-device license activation code for Laku Kasir POS. Managed by admin and claimed once by a device for permanent offline usage with automatic Device ID restore on reinstall.

code.description: Optional activation code string when stored inside an auto-ID document (e.g., RAFDEF-GGCU-594V).

appId.description: Optional target application identifier (e.g., laku-kasir or com.aistudio.lakukasir.pro). Ignored when empty.

status.description: Activation lifecycle state: available before purchase claim, used permanently once activated.

usedByBusinessName.description: Registered store or business name entered during first-time activation.

registeredDeviceId.description: Unique hardware/app-scoped Device ID locked to this license for auto-restore on reinstall.

usedAt.description: Server timestamp when the activation code was claimed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin generated this activation code.

notes.description: Optional admin notes for buyer tracking.

/activation_codes/{codeId}.description: One-time 1-device activation codes keyed either by activation code ID or auto-ID with a 'code' field.
